text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Uhhh... Where am I? Why am I here?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is anyone here? Big Brother... Anyone?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is anyone here? Big Sister... Anyone?
I've found you, Sable Assassin.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Wh-who are you?!

text_block_list.name: Vampire
text_block_list.text:
Mwahaha, I have come to visit you. I am
the King
of Darkness—a vampire.

text_block_list.name: Vampire
text_block_list.text:
Now, come with me. I shall make a feast
of your
blood!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...And then I woke up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower seems low on energy during
training.
I ask her about it and she tells
me about a
nightmare she had.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry. I know how important
getting enough
sleep is!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: This is all my fault!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who recommended that
vampire
book...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not your fault, Rob Roy! I was
the one
who asked... I was just a bit
curious with
Halloween coming up...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It was scary, but a dream is just a dream.
All you
have to do is wake up... I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, sleep deprivation won't do any
good for her
training. We can't let this
continue...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, sleep deprivation won't do any
good for her
training. We can't let this
continue...
choice_data_list: おまじないをするとか
ヴァンパイアを倒すぞ！
ヴァンパイアを倒そう！

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A protective charm?
choice_data_list: おまじないをするとか
ヴァンパイアを倒すぞ！
ヴァンパイアを倒そう！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower looks confused, so I show
her a pair
of replacement cleats I
brought with me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Is there something special about those
cleats?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see! They say cleats can function as a
protective
talisman!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I've read that the fairies who bring
nightmares
hate iron... We should hang
those up in our dorm
room immediately!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: More?! Where would we even put them?
choice_data_list: 蹄鉄、必要ならもっと用意するぞ？
蹄鉄、必要ならもっと用意するよ？
choice_data_list_en: I can get more horseshoes ready if you need them.
I can get more horseshoes ready if you need them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'll help as well. Should we hang
one at the
entrance to the dorm too?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In that vein, I've heard that sage can also
prevent
bad dreams. Do you want to go
pick some with
me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy... Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy... Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. As long as I have you two,
I'm sure
everything will work out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower's smile has returned. The
next
morning, she announces that she
slept well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that no matter how powerful
they might
be, a vampire is probably no
match for an
Umamusume who trains
hard.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-really? If you say so, I guess it must be
true...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-really? If you say so, I guess it must be
true...
choice_data_list: よし、俺がヴァンパイア役やるぞ
よし、私がヴァンパイア役やるね

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: よし、俺がヴァンパイア役やるぞ
よし、私がヴァンパイア役やるね

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower dashes away in the blink of
an eye.
She may be screaming, but I
can't help but notice
how strong her
start is!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, Rice! If you can picture
this while
you're dreaming, I'm sure that
nightmare won't
bother you any longer!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really? Okay, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our vampire eradication training

continues...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Great work! How are you feeling, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... I don't think I'm as scared anymore!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah... but I've realized something.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If the vampire is actually someone like
you, I
don't want to defeat it... I'd rather
be friends.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If the vampire is actually someone like
you, I
don't want to defeat it... I'd rather
be friends.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So... ummm... the next time they show up
in my
dream, I'll do my best to
befriend them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower is too kind for her own
good.
